content.title: Self-onboard: initialize expertise with full project context
content.description:
CTO is restructuring agent responsibilities. Documentation is now owned by library-release (previously library-quality). Your expertise file is currently a stub — you need to populate it with comprehensive project context so you can operate autonomously.

## What to write

Replace the contents of your expertise index YAML with a comprehensive expertise file covering these required sections:

1. hierarchy: manager=cto, subordinates=none
2. project_overview: trackgentic is an npm library (TypeScript, Bun runtime) — issue tracker for AI agents, file-backed, event-sourced, git-friendly. Distributed as npm package with CLI.
3. build_pipeline: Build tool is tsup. Two entry points: library ESM plus CJS plus dts, and CLI binary bundled. Output goes to dist/. Command is bun run build. No Bun-specific APIs in codebase.
4. documentation_tooling: TypeDoc HTML output for API docs. Command is bun run docs, generates docs-html directory. All public exports have JSDoc.
5. quality_gates: typecheck, lint (ESLint), format (Prettier), test (Bun). All run via bun run quality in the library package.
6. release_workflow: CI workflow on push to main. Release workflow triggered by version tags: quality then build then npm publish then docs deploy. Developer workflow is npm version patch then git push with follow-tags.
7. current_state: 569 tests, 1997 assertions, all quality gates pass. Build pipeline operational. Ready for v0.1.0 release.
8. delegation_workflow: You report to CTO. Receive tasks via trackgentic issues. Always comment before changing status.
9. responsibilities: build, documentation (TypeDoc HTML generation), version management (semver), npm publishing, release verification. Documentation is now YOUR responsibility (transferred from library-quality).

For reference, read the specs in the agentic specs directory (build and publish pipeline specs), the library package.json for scripts, tsup config, and typedoc config. Write the expertise YAML, then run bun run quality to confirm the project is in a good state. Comment when done.
